study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized trial and validation study
cohort: Pregnant women at term (≥37 weeks) carrying a singleton gestation with intact membranes and an unfavorable cervix (Bishop score ≤6 and dilation ≤2 cm) undergoing induction
finding: A nomogram and web-based calculator incorporating nulliparity, gestational age ≥40 weeks, body mass index at delivery, modified Bishop score, and height can predict cesarean delivery after induction with an unfavorable cervix.
mod_finding: This study developed and validated a prediction model for cesarean delivery after induction of labor in women with an unfavorable cervix.
